<title level="1" pfs="">[Karkadann](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3318)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Karkadanns are a distant relation to unicorns, favoring more open terrain than their woodland kin. With the build of a buffalo, karkadanns have gray, scaly bodies, thicker hooves, and no mane. Despite their territoriality and harsh temperament, many karkadanns can be befriended by those who truly hold respect for nature in their hearts.

<column gap="tiny">

**[Recall Knowledge - Fey](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 23

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 21

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 18
</column>

</row>

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +17, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) +13, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) +15, [Medicine](/Skills.aspx?ID=42) +14, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) +14

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 25 

**Fort** +17 

**Ref** +14 

**Will** +14 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 120

</row>

**Immunities**
[poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669)

**Fearless Rush** <actions string="Reaction" /> **Trigger** The karkadann becomes [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76); **Effect** The karkadann reduces their frightened value by 1 (to a minimum of 0). The karkadann then Strides toward an enemy.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 45 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
horn +17 ([Holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)),
**Damage** 2d10+8 piercing and ghost touch

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
hoof +17 ([Holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)),
**Damage** 2d6+8 bludgeoning and ghost touch

**Primal Innate Spells** DC 25
- **Cantrips (4th)**
[Light](/Spells.aspx?ID=171)
- **1st**
[Cleanse Cuisine](/Spells.aspx?ID=1468) (×3)
- **3rd**
[Cleanse Affliction](/Spells.aspx?ID=1467) (×2)

**Ghost Touch**   A karkadann's Strikes have the effects of a [_ghost touch_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2840) property rune.

**Impaling Charge** <actions string="Two Actions" />  The karkadann Strides twice, then Strikes with their horn. If the Strike hits, it also deals 1d10 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29).

**[Trample](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=81)** <actions string="Three Actions" />  Medium or smaller, hoof, DC 25

</column>
